about: Per-firmware record of aGate Modbus behaviour (david2069/franklinwh-modbus#91). Keyed by behaviour id; each behaviour carries one observation per firmware (M1 Vr). Public facts only. Entries are never deleted: a firmware change adds an observation. Code and emulator profiles act only on status 'documented' or 'measured'.

m704_wset_sign.point: M704 WSet (int32, WSet_SF 0, PDU 320-321 at base 0)
m704_wset_sign.description: Sign of M704 WSet: which direction a positive value drives the battery.

our_assessment.basis: FranklinWH documents no sign for WSet; known only by measurement.

observations.value: positive = discharge
observations.note: c8: WSetMod=1, WSet=+5000 -> M714 DCW +4900 to +5000 W, M701 W about -4710 W, 3 of 3 runs (docs/SUNSPEC_M704_V12_CONFORMANCE_RESULTS.md).

library_handling.franklinwh-modbus: 0.10.1: send_command negates BatteryCommand.power_watts (positive = charge) into WSet (positive = discharge).

m704_wsetpct_sign.point: M704 WSetPct (int16, WSetPct_SF -1, PDU 324 at base 0)
m704_wsetpct_sign.description: Sign of M704 WSetPct: which direction a positive value drives the battery.

our_assessment.basis: FranklinWH documents no sign for WSetPct; known only by measurement.

observations.value: positive = discharge
observations.note: c1: WSetPct raw +100 (10.0 %) -> M714 DCW 500 W discharge, 3 of 3 runs.

library_handling.franklinwh-modbus: send_command negates BatteryCommand.power_pct (positive = charge) into WSetPct (positive = discharge).

m704_wsetpct_accepted_range.point: M704 WSetPct (int16, WSetPct_SF -1, PDU 324 at base 0)
m704_wsetpct_accepted_range.description: Raw WSetPct values the aGate accepts on write. Raw values; percent = raw x 10^WSetPct_SF.

our_assessment.basis: V10R01B04D00 acknowledged out-of-range values instead of exception 3 (SunSpec #12041, docs/NON_COMPLIANCE_ASSESSMENT.md). V12R02B60D00 limit is not documented; FranklinWH PICS SM-000028 gives WSetPct 0-100 and whether that is raw or percent is open (david2069/franklinwh-modbus#92).

observations.value: raw 1500 acknowledged (no exception 3)
observations.note: Raw 1000 (100 %) delivered about 4.8 kW discharge on 2026-10-20 (reported, david2069/franklinwh-modbus#92).

observations.value: raw 0 to +100 accepted (0-10.0 %); above +100 and every negative value refused with exception 3
observations.note: +101 refused 3 of 3; negatives refused (c5 -50 raw, 3 of 3). WSet positive control accepted in the same runs.

library_handling.franklinwh-modbus: A refused write is logged with register, value and firmware (#114 A4, unreleased).

m704_wset_negative_refused.point: M704 WSet (int32, WSet_SF 0, PDU 320-321 at base 0)
m704_wset_negative_refused.description: Whether a negative WSet (charge, given m704_wset_sign) is accepted on write.

our_assessment.basis: No documented limit; a refusal is exception 3 (Illegal Data Value).

observations.value: refused with exception 3
observations.note: c6: WSetMod=1, WSet=-500 W (FC16 0xFFFF 0xFE0C) while WSetEna=0, 3 of 3 runs, SoC 88-90 %. Other magnitudes and a write while enabled not tested.

library_handling.franklinwh-modbus: 0.10.1: a charge command returns the refusal ("Rejected by the aGate (...)"), no resend.

m702_wmax_write.description: Whether a write to M702 WMax changes the WSetPct reference.

our_assessment.basis: Writes acknowledged and not applied.

observations.value: acknowledged, WMax stays 0; WSetPct reference stays 5000 W
observations.note: c2, 3 of 3 runs: 10 % stays 500 W.

m704_wsetrvrttms_reversion.description: What the aGate does when the WSetRvrtTms reversion timer runs and expires.

our_assessment.basis: DER Information Model v1.2: on expiry the controller reverts to the reversion values.

observations.value: countdown runs; power not reverted at expiry
inverted: reversion value applies during the countdown, setpoint after expiry; WSetEna stays 1
observations.note: c4/c4b, 3 of 3 runs. Countdown starts when WSetRvrtTms is written.

m715_controller_heartbeat.description: Whether ControllerHb writes are kept and DERHb advances.

our_assessment.basis: Write acknowledged, read back 0.

observations.value: write acknowledged, read back 0
observations.note: Undated; firmware taken from the QUIRKS test report header.

observations.value: write acknowledged, read back 0; DERHb stays 0
observations.note: 24 FC16 writes; positive control WSetPctRvrt=50 read back.

sunspec_map_at_pdu_40000.description: Whether the SunSpec map is also served at PDU 40000 (the map starts at PDU 0).

our_assessment.basis: Map base 0 is the documented start; the mirror is not documented.

observations.value: not served: PDU 40000+ returned exception 2
served: full SunSpec map mirrored at PDU 40000

library_handling.franklinwh-modbus: Open: connect()/reconnect() ignore base_address and bind to 40000 on V12 (#84).

pdu_40000_write_response_address.description: Address echoed in the response to a write sent to the 40000 mirror.

our_assessment.basis: Modbus FC06/FC16 responses echo the request address.

observations.value: write applied; response echoes the base-0 address (40319 -> 319, 41092 -> 1092)

our_assessment.basis: V10 returned the 15508 value, not the TOU reserve.

ext_15509_tou_reserve.detectable_by_read: compare 15509 with 15508 when the app's SC and TOU reserves differ

observations.value: same as 15508 (SC 8, TOU 15 in the app; 15509 read 8)
TOU reserve (read 15, app TOU 15)

our_assessment.basis: Not documented by FranklinWH.

observations.value: 8, equal to 15508, in Self-Consumption
observations.note: Read in one mode only, so SC reserve and active reserve can't be told apart.

observations.value: active reserve: 8 in Self-Consumption, 15 in Time of Use, 100 in Emergency Backup
observations.note: SC, TOU and EB read 2026-10-21 AEDT (#63); EB read again 2026-10-28 with the same result. Whether the EB reserve is ever other than 100 is not verified.

ext_15507_15509_writes.description: Effect of writes to the mode and reserve extension registers. FranklinWH has not documented any extension register as writable.

our_assessment.basis: No documented write mechanism.

observations.value: acknowledged, not applied (mode and reserves unchanged)
observations.note: Two independent tools; values restored.

library_handling.franklinwh-modbus: Treated as read-only; each write's read-back is reported.

m714_dcv_tmp.point: M714 Prt.1.DCV (1073, uint16, DCV_SF), Prt.1.Tmp (1083, int16, Tmp_SF)
m714_dcv_tmp.description: Whether M714 DC voltage and battery temperature carry values.

our_assessment.basis: FranklinWH PICS (SunSpec certificate SM-000028) declares the point supported R; it returns 0, not the not-implemented value (DCV 0xFFFF, Tmp 0x8000), so 0 V / 0 °C cannot be told from a reading.

m714_dcv_tmp.detectable_by_read: DCV and Tmp both 0 while DCW is non-zero

observations.value: listed as working in our docs; no raw read on record (the 2026-05-14 scan did not read the port block)
observations.note: Undated and unsourced; kept as reported, not measured.

observations.value: DCV 0, Tmp 0 (not the not-implemented values) while model DCW was -600 W

library_handling.franklinwh-modbus: read_battery_status() never reads the port block (it looks for a 'blocks' attribute pysunspec2 models lack), so battery_temp_c and per-port voltage_v/temp_c are a library default 0 on any firmware (#130).

m714_dca.point: M714 DCA (1047) and Prt.1.DCA (1072), int16, DCA_SF
m714_dca.description: Whether M714 reports battery DC current.

our_assessment.basis: FranklinWH PICS (SunSpec certificate SM-000028) declares the point supported R; it returns 0, not 0x8000, while DCW is non-zero.

observations.value: model DCA 0 while DCW was +500 W
observations.note: Single read. Port block not read.

observations.value: model DCA 0 and Prt.1.DCA 0 while model DCW was -600 W
observations.note: Single read.

library_handling.franklinwh-modbus: read_battery_status() uses model DCA, else model DCW / port DCV; it never reads port DCV (#130), so battery_current_a is 0 whenever DCA is 0.

m714_port_block.point: M714 port 1 block (1062-1086): PrtTyp, IDStr, DCW, DCWhInj, DCWhAbs, DCSta, DCAlrm
m714_port_block.description: Whether the M714 port 1 block describes the battery.

our_assessment.basis: FranklinWH PICS (SunSpec certificate SM-000028) declares the point supported R for each of these; it returns 0 (PrtTyp 0 = PV, DCSta 0 = OFF) and a placeholder IDStr, and port DCW and energy disagree with the model totals.

m714_port_block.detectable_by_read: Prt.1.DCW 0 while model DCW is non-zero

observations.value: PrtTyp 0 (PV), IDStr 'ID_String', DCW 0, DCWhInj 0, DCWhAbs 0, DCSta 0 (OFF), DCAlrm 0; model DCW -600 W, model DCWhInj/DCWhAbs non-zero; NPrt 1
observations.note: Single read. V10 port block never read.

library_handling.franklinwh-modbus: read_battery_status() never reads the port block (it looks for a 'blocks' attribute pysunspec2 models lack); individual_batteries[0] carries the model-level DCW (#130).
